# Sample Script 01

## Concept
Busy-morning TikTok Shop UGC for a portable blender.

## Target Duration
20–24 seconds

## Hook
“没时间做早餐？我现在连奶昔都是出门路上现打。”

## Script Beats

### Beat 1 — Hook / Morning chaos
- Creator in kitchen, slightly rushed, holding fruit and gym bag.
- Says: “没时间做早餐？我现在连奶昔都是出门路上现打。”

### Beat 2 — Product reveal
- Quick close-up of the portable blender on counter.
- Says: “这个随行榨汁杯真的救了我这种早上永远赶时间的人。”

### Beat 3 — Ingredients + ease
- Creator drops cut banana, berries, and milk into blender.
- Says: “把水果切好丢进去，按一下就行。”

### Beat 4 — Blending demo
- Handheld close-up of blender running.
- Says: “它不是那种很占地方的大机器，这种随手带走真的方便。”

### Beat 5 — Portability / transition
- Creator grabs blender and leaves home; next shot in car or outside gym.
- Says: “我直接带着走，通勤路上或者健身后喝都很方便。”

### Beat 6 — Result / lifestyle payoff
- Creator drinks smoothie and looks relieved / satisfied.
- Says: “早上终于不是乱糟糟随便对付一口了。”

### Beat 7 — CTA
- Creator holds product to camera.
- Says: “如果你也总是赶时间但又想吃得健康一点，这个真的可以看看。”
